scope: Raw frozen assessments; notes are initial reviewer judgments, not final technical findings. Read autosave-carry-1.5.0.md for source reconciliation and rejected claims. No adoption decisions.

scores.note: save_restore.c:1259 passes a negative delay; Base ca_client_context.cpp:578-595 reduces it to zero. Narrow correction restores intended minimum delay; no runtime timing test.
print_chmod_error has two uninitialized stack buffers for unlisted errno; default initializes both before printf. No injected filesystem-error runtime test.
